messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to flip `quant_profile=dynamic_int8` for models/gpt-small in staging canary. Need a scope check + guardrails before we press it. Details below.

josh: Canary audience suggestion: 2% of staging traffic (route: /api/v1/generate, tag=playground). Rollout window 24h. Metric watchers: smoke_eval quality, cost/token, p95/p99 latency, memory OOMs. What do we want as rollback criteria?

anya: Rollback criteria proposal: quality drop >3% (on our smoke eval) OR absolute quality drop >5% on any critical prompt group. Perf rollback: p95 latency increase >20% or error rate up >1% absolute. Also require zero OOMs. Sound reasonable?

liwei: Add auto circuit-breaker: if error-rate >0.5% sustained over 5m, auto-disable the canary flag and page oncall. I'll add alert rules to infra.alerts.quant_canary.

maria: Also want an offline micro-eval run before canary: 1k prompts comparing fp16/int8/int4 to capture token-level divergence + log-prob deltas. I ran a quick local: int8 showed ~0.8% degradation on smoke set. Command I used: ```python tools/eval/compare_precision.py --model gpt-small --profiles fp16,int8 --batch 32 --out /tmp/quant_eval.json```

josh: :eyes: Please post the PR link for the flag change and the rollout config. Need to check runtime KV-cache interactions for int8 path.

anya: PR posted: https://git.redwood/infr/rollouts/pulls/1249 — contains `flags.quant.profile=dynamic_int8` and `flags.quant.canary=staging:2%`. Includes unit tests and a simple smoke check but needs @josh runtime review.

josh: Reviewing now. Quick note: for `dynamic_int8` we must fallback to `fp16` if `kv_checksum` mismatch detected at decode time. I'll comment on PR to add the fallback hook.

deploy-bot: Canary started for flags.quant.profile=dynamic_int8 on staging (2% traffic). Watch infra.alerts.quant_canary. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/1769999999

liwei: Alert rules added: `quant_canary_tail_latency` and `quant_canary_quality_drop`. Will page if thresholds hit. Also hooked periodic snapshots (5m) of p50/p95/p99 and error rates.

anya: Thanks — when PR gets approved and canary is live, ping me at 6h so I can run the larger 10k offline eval and diff token-level outputs. If everything looks good we proceed to 10% for 12h then ramp. :shipit:

maria: Runbook update reminder: please add the guardrail thresholds and the kill command to /runbooks/quant_rollout.md. Kill command example: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://controlplane/flags/disable -d '{"flag":"flags.quant.canary"}'```

josh: Added KV checksum fallback and a unit test for cache integrity. Tests passed locally, leaving an approval. :heavy_check_mark:

anya: Final plan summary: keep canary at 2% for 24h; if stable (no quality regressions, latency within thresholds, no OOMs) bump to 10% for 12h; then stagger ramp to 25% and 100% with manual checkpoints. Immediate rollback on any alert or if offline eval shows >3% quality regression.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. I'll monitor dashboards and post hourly status in this thread. :thumbsup:
